role_summary: Primary launcher. Now defaults to the thesis core profile and can also run exploratory, utility, or full profiles.
Mirror launcher copy retained for compatibility with the cleaned workflow wrapper.
Validates DNA BAM integrity and creates missing BAM indices before downstream QC and calling.
Runs the primary DNA QC workflow and produces cohort-level QC summaries used to define pass/fail status.
Builds PASS manifests and zero-coverage summaries from the DNA QC outputs; required for core calling inputs.
Formats zero-coverage outputs into an Excel report for review; useful documentation but not a core dependency.
Generates DNA QC plots and audit tables for supervisor-facing review and presentation.
Performs technical amplicon audits and highlights poorly performing regions for diagnostics.
Creates per-locus failed-versus-passed amplicon visualisations for diagnostic follow-up.
Builds an overview panel of the worst flagged amplicon failures from the 04b visualisation outputs.
Runs targeted variant calling on QC-passed DNA BAMs and produces the filtered cohort VCFs used downstream.
Force-genotypes the union of observed loci across all sequenced samples so downstream scripts can distinguish wild-type, non-carrier, and missing calls explicitly.
Annotates filtered VCFs with VEP and external resources to create the canonical variant annotation layer.
Merges annotated VCFs into the canonical project workbook that underpins the SNP branch of the pipeline.
Performs variant-level QC checks on the merged annotation workbook for diagnostic assurance.
Compares the designed BED against the detected variants and summarises design-versus-observed coverage.
Creates global variant landscape figures and tables; descriptive and presentation-facing rather than core-generative.
Creates GSDMB-focused landscape figures and tables for descriptive reporting.
Compares normal and tumour landscape patterns as a follow-up sensitivity layer to the descriptive plots.
Generates descriptive variant consequence and impact summaries for reporting.
Defines the common-SNP backbone and benchmarking tables used by the core SNP analyses.
Runs the principal tumour-versus-control SNP enrichment analyses that support objective 1.
Adds a permutation-based sensitivity analysis for the SNP branch; informative but not required for the canonical rerun.
Builds an interactive dashboard for exploratory review of the variant results.
Builds the phased cohort haplotype matrix used by the haplotype and RNA integration branches.
Produces the principal haplotype frequency and association results for the thesis haplotype branch.
Bootstraps missing R dependencies for the haplotype statistics runtime when needed.
Builds the harmonised master workbook that anchors the clinical and RNA branches.
Runs the main SNP association suite: tumour-versus-control testing, tumour-cohort clinical models, genotype-dose summaries, and secondary survival or risk follow-up.
Rare-variant and burden follow-up on the locus-level DNA signal; useful secondary association analysis rather than core discovery.
Runs the main haplotype association suite: tumour-versus-control testing, tumour-cohort clinical models, haplotype-dose summaries, and secondary survival or risk follow-up.
Places study haplotypes in an external 1000 Genomes context; secondary validation rather than main discovery.
Builds the RNA QC manifest that gates the objective-2 RNA analyses.
Runs the workbook-first isoform and RNA association workflow for thesis objective 2.
Adds BAM-derived panel-gene expression quantification used by the RNA integration layer.
Produces a compact collaborator-facing core haplotype summary when the external workbook is available.
Builds an interpretation layer for significant haplotypes; useful downstream context but not a required core generator.
Integrates RNA, significant SNPs, and significant haplotypes for the final thesis objective-2 reporting layer.
Historical TCGA-preparation helper retained only for reference; it is not part of the active pipeline because the TCGA germline branch was not accessible.
Runs external breast and endometrial validation against female-only 1000 Genomes reference samples.
Performs a focused follow-up analysis on the rs11078928 and rs869402 haplotypic context.
Adds a SNP biological interpretation layer combining annotations, RNA context, and optional external support.
Historical paired breast tumour-normal prototype retained only for reference; it is not part of the active pipeline because the breast BAM cohort is unpaired.
Audits sample concordance, aliasing, and identity separation across the study set.
Bundles significant survival-curve pages into thesis-friendly PDFs and an index.
Shared runtime defaults used by the association and RNA scripts to keep paths and thresholds aligned.
Shared export helpers used by the core objective-2 RNA workflow.
Shared RNA QC and matching helpers used by stages 19b and 20.
Shared config and helper utilities used across the core and optional workflows.
Builds a compact DNA/RNA sample-count report from the current QC outputs so thesis reruns always expose total-versus-passing counts.
Shared validation helpers that keep analytical assumptions and input checks consistent.
Shared plotting style helpers reused by multiple reporting and association scripts.
